projections.source_time_basis: Retained HYCOM January/July15,2022 00Z snapshots; no new provider fields or independent observations.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite100–400m eastward integral in declared5.5–3S subset; resolved primary10cm/s lower contour.
projections.branch_scope: Partial primary southern Tsuchiya-jet-context140–120W reach,with5.5–3S searches. Exclude secondary southern jet,northern jet,equatorial EUC,SECC and detached eddies as target identities. Retained110/100W windows are outside the declared reach because literature poleward movement can exceed their southern coverage;no eastern continuation or full jet route is admitted. Gates can still truncate main-jet meanders and maxima need not identify a coherent branch. Historical Rowe2000/Johnson2002 archives,mean-core depths and PV/density fronts do not validate2022 model axes or physical boundaries.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
